scripts.web: npm run build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/publish-web.ps1
scripts.appimage: npm run build && cd desktop && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --linux AppImage
scripts.apk: npm run build && cd mobile && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx cap sync android && node ../scripts/slim-android.mjs && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$PWD/../../.tools/jdk" ANDROID_HOME="$PWD/../../.tools/android-sdk" ./gradlew assembleDebug
